class.name: ResourceImporterIES
class.brief_description: Imports an ANSI/IESNA LM-63 photometric light profile ([code].ies[/code]) as an [IESProfile] resource.
class.description: Imports ASCII [code].ies[/code] files conforming to ANSI/IESNA LM-63-1995 or LM-63-2002 ([code]TILT=NONE[/code]), resamples their candela distribution (including photometric types C, B, and A and horizontal symmetries) into a normalized 256×64 half-float table, and saves an [IESProfile] resource for use on [OmniLight3D], [SpotLight3D], and [AreaLight3D]. Files declaring [code]TILT=INCLUDE[/code] or external tilt files are rejected with an import error.
